gate1.baseline_interpretation: Core-misfit historical attribution supports forward paper tracking, not live shorting.

validation: focused TSM/ISRG sizing tests: 3 passed, 321 deselected

hypothesis: Historical negative-for-core ticker signals should be tracked forward in a production-visible default-off paper sleeve before any live exclusion or short-side experiment.
known_risks: Forward sample will mature slowly because the ticker cohort is narrow.
Inverse paper outcomes still ignore borrow and short locate costs.
This adapter is observation-only and should not be interpreted as live short permission.
next_evidence_needed: At least 20 closed 10-day CORE_MISFIT_PAPER outcomes with positive no-trade value and inverse paper PnL before any separate live exclusion or short experiment.
single_causal_variable: production-visible default-off CORE_MISFIT_PAPER ledger adapter only
why_not_other_changes: No live short adapter, no core exclusion, and no ticker scalar changes were added because exp-20260516-043 only justified forward paper tracking.
